title: QATL HO GAYE QASIM YA ALI DUHAAI HAI
body:
Hai lahu bhara Chehra kaisi runumaai hai
Dekhne ko ye manzar ab Dulhan bhi Aayi hai
Ek din ki thi Shaadi hashr tak judaai hai
Karbala ke Dulha ki Laash ghar meAayi hai
<<MINI>>
Qatl hogaye Qasim Ya Ali duhaai hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Do jaha'n na kyun rowe ye Ali ka Pota hai
Bekasi pa Qasim ki dil shikista hota hai
Ye zameen Rothi hai aasma'n bhi rota hai
Ab kisi ko sakta hai koi jaan khota hai
<<MINI>>
Qatl ho gaye Qasim Ya Ali duhaai hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis liye tadapte hain kisko jaa ke samjhaaein
Kya guzarti hai Ham par Woto bas Khuda Jaane
Qalb bhi Hamare hain Shaah ke Azakhaane
Hain azaaye Qasim me aasuon ke nazraane
<<MINI>>
Qatl ho gaye Qasim Ya Ali duhaai hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj Karbala waale phir hamare mehma hain
Phool ho'n ke mehndi ho sab Aza ke saama'n hain
Ehtemaam shaadi ke ek Bahan ke armaa'n hain
Ghamzado'n ke nazraane aansuon ke toofaa'n hain
<<MINI>>
Qatl ho gaye Qasim Ya Ali duhaai hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye Sadaa-e Maatam hai ek payaame bedaari
Is liye rago'n me hai khoone zindagi jaari
Zindagi Hamari hai Shaah ki Azadaari
Khud shareeke Majlis hai ek Ghareeb Dukhiyaari
<<MINI>>
Qatl ho gaye Qasim Ya Ali duhaai hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ran se Laasha-eNaoshah laay jis ghadi Sarwar
Zindagi ka har lamha phir to ban gaya nashtar
Har qadam qayamat thi har qadam pa tha mehshar
Reh gaya nigaho'n me ye lahu bhara manzar
<<MINI>>
Qatl ho gaye Qasim Ya Ali duhaai hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Bain the ye Kubra ke ab to ghut raha hai dam
Bolte nahi'n kuch bhi aaj Mere Ibne amm
Kis tarah se dikhlaaein apne dil ka ye aalam
Boliye PhupiAmma chup rahein ke roe'nham
<<MINI>>
Qatl ho gaye Qasim Ya Ali duhaai hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Misle Fatima Kubra kaunsi Dulhan hogi
Sar to berida hoga haath me rasan hogi
Laash jiske waaris ki ran me bekafan hogi
Aye Rafi is Ghamme qaom seenazan hogi
<<MINI>>
Qatl ho gaye Qasim Ya Ali duhaai hai
author: Ali Rafi
